notes.title: Unleash Your Parkour Skills on Linux and Steam Deck!
notes.content: We are thrilled to announce that "Poly Parkour" is now available on the latest release of Linux and the exciting new platform, Steam Deck! Get ready to experience the heart-pounding action and challenging gameplay on these supported platforms. Jump, run, and conquer obstacles like never before. Grab your Steam Deck or fire up your Linux system and prepare for an unforgettable parkour adventure!
